description: Box 3 tax on savings and investments in the Netherlands for 2026 (the notional-return system): the tax-free allowance, the notional return on savings, investments and debts, and the 36% tax. Optionally for fiscal partners (double allowance).

debts.description: Debts in Box 3 on 1 January (not the mortgage on your own home), euros

fiscal_partner.description: Filing together with a fiscal partner (amounts are the couple's total). Default false.

investments.description: Investments and other assets (shares, crypto, a second home) on 1 January, euros

savings.description: Bank and savings balances on 1 January, euros

name: box3_wealth_tax
title: Dutch Box 3 wealth tax
